---
name: implementation
description: Implement one Story with minimal scope, maintainable code, appropriate tests and explicit evidence.
argument-hint: "[Story]"
---

# Story Implementation

1. Read Story and QA Quality Contract.
2. Inspect architecture and existing code.
3. Identify affected components.
4. Implement the smallest maintainable change.
5. Add appropriate implementation-level tests.
6. Run checks.
7. Review diff.
8. Report deviations.

Do not redesign unrelated components or silently change business behavior.
